name: Analyze contact import file
description: Call this when you have a contact file (e.g. CSV) and need Brevo to parse its headers and propose an attribute mapping before any contacts are actually imported. This is the first step of the file-based import flow: it returns the detected columns, sample values, inferred data types and which header maps to email/SMS/WhatsApp, so a later step can confirm the mapping and run the import. Use contacts.suggest_mapping_from_file instead if you only need a mapping suggestion for headers you already hold, and use the import-notification action (contacts.get_import_notification) to follow the progress of an import that has already been started. Do not use this to add a single known contact — use contacts.create_contact or contacts.update_contact for that.
preconditions: The session must be authenticated against the Brevo web app (contacts-api-v2.brevo.com).
A contact file must be available to upload as multipart/form-data.
The uploaded file must contain a header row, since the response is built from the detected headers.

import_file.description: The contact file to analyze, sent as a multipart/form-data file part. Observed with a .csv file and Content-Type text/csv.

language.description: UI language code used for the parsing/mapping response, e.g. "en" as observed.

mappingDataHeader.description: Column headers detected in the uploaded file, in file order.

mapping_data.description: One entry per detected header, keyed by the header name.

data.description: Sample values taken from the file's first rows for this column.

datatype.description: Inferred data type for the column, e.g. "text".

mapped.description: Whether the column was matched to an existing contact attribute ("1" when mapped).

contact_id_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the contact id, or "NO" when absent.

ext_id_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the external id, or "NO" when absent.

email_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the email address, or "NO" when absent.

mobile_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the mobile number, or "NO" when absent.

whatsapp_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the WhatsApp number, or "NO" when absent.

landline_tag_position.description: Zero-based index of the column holding the landline number, or "NO" when absent.

maxTranAttId.description: Highest transactional attribute id on the account.

maxUserAttId.description: Highest normal (user) contact attribute id on the account.

usersAttr.description: Existing contact attributes available as mapping targets.

field_key.description: Internal key for the attribute, e.g. "firstname".

side_effects: The uploaded file is sent to Brevo and held server-side for the subsequent import step.
Contact attribute metadata for the account is read and returned.
